title: Schedule of Fees and Charges: Annual Rent and Billing Terms, Safe Deposit Boxes
content:
Annual rent for Safe Deposit Boxes is set by box size. The figure in this schedule is the annual rent before the branch adjustment and before any discount.

## Annual rent before branch adjustment and discounts

| Size | Annual rent |
| --- | --- |
| 3x5 Safe Deposit Box | $65.00 |
| 3x10 Safe Deposit Box | $85.00 |
| 5x10 Safe Deposit Box | $120.00 |
| 10x10 Safe Deposit Box | $175.00 |
| 10x15 Safe Deposit Box | $240.00 |
| 10x20 Safe Deposit Box | $325.00 |

## Branch adjustment

Each branch carries a percent added to, or taken from, the base rent. The same adjustment applies to every size in that vault.

| Branch | Adjustment to the base rent |
| --- | --- |
| Greensboro Main Office | none |
| Winston-Salem Reynolda Road | none |
| Charlotte SouthPark | 15 percent added |
| Raleigh North Hills | 10 percent added |
| Greenville Main Street | none |
| Roanoke Market Square | 5 percent taken off |

Two of the six vaults carry an addition, one carries a reduction, and at the remaining three the base rent stands unadjusted.

## Billing terms

The following terms are the same for every size.

| Term | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Length of one rental term | 12 months |
| Renewal at the end of each term | automatic |
| Notice sent before the rent due date | 30 calendar days |
| Notice before a rent change takes effect at renewal | 30 calendar days |
| Most rental years payable in advance | 3 years |
| Discount on rent for years prepaid beyond the current one | 5 percent |
| Ways rent may be paid | automatic debit from a PCB checking account; transfer from a PCB checking account; cash; check |

Stated as a point of basis: the rent figure named in the size table is the figure before the branch adjustment and before any discount, so the amount a lessee is billed for a year is not read off that table alone. The branch adjustment percent is a property of the vault, not of the size, and is therefore the same for a 3x5 Safe Deposit Box and a 10x20 Safe Deposit Box held in the same branch.
